name: What is the difference between a whole-home remodel and a major renovation of specific rooms?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a whole-home remodel and a major renovation of specific rooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: A whole-home remodel involves a coordinated transformation across multiple rooms, often addressing inconsistent finishes, inefficient layouts, and outdated systems throughout the entire property to create a cohesive aesthetic and improved functionality. Major renovations of specific rooms, such as a luxury kitchen or spa-inspired bathroom, focus on deep transformations within those defined spaces. With AKN Design Group, whether it's a comprehensive whole-home project or a targeted, high-value renovation, our integrated design-build process ensures a single, accountable team manages the project from design planning to final walkthrough, tailored to your specific needs and scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: A whole-home remodel coordinates changes across the entire property, while major renovations focus on specific rooms like kitchens or bathrooms. Both benefit from AKN Design Group's integrated design-build process for a unified approach.
